headline: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda Stresses Need to Continue Raising Rates
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda stated in parliament that the central bank should continue raising interest rates while anchoring underlying inflation around its 2% target.
why: Bank of Japan policy trajectory determines government bond yields, domestic lending conditions, and the valuation of the Japanese yen.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Signaling continued rate hikes supports currency valuation against peers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish comments regarding ongoing monetary policy normalization reinforced expectations of further rate increases by the central bank.
